title: ContextResult
description: Which sense of a word applies in one sentence. Also the exact Structured Outputs schema for the live /context model call.

senseIndex.description: Index into DictionaryEntry.senses. Out-of-range values are clamped to 0 by the API and logged.

meaning.description: Hindi meaning as used in this sentence. Usually the chosen sense's `meaning`, occasionally tightened.

note.description: Hindi, at most two lines: why this sense, and what the word is NOT here when that is the likely confusion.
